quotes.verbatim_quote: guitarists who play finger-style have a huge advantage over those who play only with a pick.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Central pedagogical claim about technique choice.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
Finger-style guitarists can use barres and 1/2 barres and 1/3 barres to get the job done.
And they can pluck only those strings that are involved.

Octave insertion is just what you might guess: inserting an octave between any 2 voices
within a 3-part chord or a 4-part chord.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Operative definition of the chapter's key concept.

quotes.verbatim_quote: all of this applies to the 3-part 4th voicings as well
